column1: # doc-budgets.tsv — word ceilings for accretion-prone standing docs.
# Format: <path><TAB><ceiling><TAB><target>
#   ceiling — hard limit; CI fails above it (wc -w semantics, whole file)
#   target  — the size we actually want; ceiling ratchets toward it
# THE RATCHET (borrowed from dsh's doc-budgets note):
#   - a doc at or below target keeps ~5% headroom as its ceiling, and the
#     ceiling ratchets DOWN as the doc shrinks
#   - a doc ABOVE target keeps a FROZEN ceiling at its current size: it
#     cannot grow at all until it comes back to target
# Both agent-instruction files are currently frozen. They are ~2x the
# size of the comparable file in dsh (root AGENTS.md ≤ 1600 words) and
# they grew again in the change that added this gate. Freezing is the
# point: from here, adding a paragraph requires displacing one.
# SCOPE IS DELIBERATELY NARROW. Only the standing instruction files that
# every session pays for in prompt tokens are budgeted. Reference docs,
# PRDs, pitfalls.md and the analysis docs are NOT listed and must not be:
# length is legitimate there when every line is a fact, and a blanket
# ceiling would punish exactly the right kind of long document.
# Raising a ceiling requires explicit justification in the PR. Lowering
# one needs nothing.
AGENTS.md
CLAUDE.md
